svg.text: Charm Adventure in Tomato Land: character designs v1
For approval. Flat vector, thick outline, large heads. Each figure is built from separate parts for cutout animation.
striped tee, goatee, hoop earring, frying pan
patterned dress, crossbody bag as weapon
Open choices: weapons (frying pan, bag) are my proposal. Cherry, Beefsteak and Hopper exist in the build as boxes; the other five are proposals.
